name: Verein KlimaSeniorinnen Schweiz v Switzerland

jurisdiction.court: European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) - Grand Chamber

description: Application no. 53600/20. An association of over 2,000 elderly Swiss women (Elderly Women for Climate Protection), particularly vulnerable to heatwaves, complained that the Swiss government's climate inaction and inadequate emission-reduction policies violated their human rights, including exposure to harmful effects (among them air quality) arising from climate change.
outcome: Violation of Articles 8 and 6 ECHR. Historic judgment: for the first time the ECtHR recognised that States have positive obligations under Article 8 to adopt effective climate change mitigation measures, with binding targets and carbon budgets, in order to protect private life, health and well-being. The Swiss government subsequently refused to comply fully, giving rise to controversy over execution.
